== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Spirit Well]] [[water]] is a highly valuable, vivid blue liquid that functions as a potent spiritual enhancer. Described as tasting sweet, it is significantly larger than the [[Dream Well]], resembling a pond more than a traditional well. The [[water]] serves several critical purposes: it promotes soul growth, accelerates recovery, and increases the density of [[madra]]. [[Consuming]] even small amounts can push a [[Highgold]] cultivator to the edge of [[advancement]], and it can be used to nourish cores and channels or to recharge energy in [[constructs]] like the [[Heaven's Drop]]. While it is considered the cheapest of three specific types of well [[water]], a single cup remains extremely expensive. It is used by cultivators to push toward higher ranks, such as [[Truegold]], and acts as a vital resource for replenishing spiritual energy.}}
